embed.title: !tracked
embed.description: Show your status and every tracking rule in your current profile, grouped by type, plus any active mutes.

fields.name: Usage
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}tracked` — status, rules and mutes
`{{prefix}}tracked area` — just the areas you have selected

fields.name: What you see
fields.value:
• Whether alerts are on, your location, areas and active profile
• Each rule with an `[id:XX]` in front of it
• ⚠️ on rules that can't match yet: a `d:` rule with no location set, or an area rule with no areas selected
• Active mutes and how long they have left

If the list is long, it is sent as a text file instead.

fields.name: Using the ids
fields.value:
Ids are numbered separately for each type, so say which type you mean:
`{{prefix}}untrack id:45` — a pokemon rule
`{{prefix}}raid remove id:12` or `{{prefix}}untrack raid id:12` — a raid rule (same pattern for egg, quest, invasion, and the rest)
`{{prefix}}raid mute id:12 duration:2h` — pause a rule instead of removing it

fields.name: Related commands
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}script` — your tracking as a list of commands you can re-run (useful as a backup)
`{{prefix}}profile` — switch to another tracking profile
`{{prefix}}help mute` — muting alerts
